diagnostics_final_interpretation.headline: Phase III.2 produced exploratory leads with ε saturation warning.
scientific_read: Positive conditional lift rows were detected: 13. Primary positive rows: 1.
Phase III.2D multichannel EEG produced exploratory positive lift rows: 7.
No strong candidate rows satisfied lift, epsilon, subject-consistency and BIC criteria simultaneously.
No Phase III.2D multichannel row satisfied all strong-candidate criteria.
Negative controls collapsed under the leakage-safe criteria, including multichannel-aware controls.
F7 failed: subject-level consistency was insufficient for a strong claim.
F8 failed: the augmented conditional model was not favored by BIC.
F12 warning: ε saturation remains present and must be treated as a diagnostic limitation.
Not evaluated in this standalone diagnostic run: ['F1', 'F5'].
Phase III.2E remains protocol-only because Sleep-EDF and ANU QRNG were not synchronously co-acquired.
diagnostics_final_interpretation.recommendation: Treat Phase III.2A/B/C/D as an exploratory lead only. Controls passed, including multichannel-aware controls, but F7/F8 failed and F12 raised an ε saturation warning. Do not claim EEG-RNG coupling. Document III.2D as an exploratory multichannel enrichment that increased positive-lift rows but did not satisfy subject-consistency, BIC and saturation requirements. Keep III.2E as a future synchronized EEG + QRNG protocol.
